messages:
elaine_sales: Heads up — ZenPort RFI due EOD Friday. They specifically asked for: capability matrix, a POC plan (2-week), pricing buckets including burst rates, and completed security questionnaire. Any major blockers we should flag?
chris_sales_eng: quick q — for the POC do they want Dedicated reserved nodes or hosted API? ZenPort mentioned 'on-prem-like isolation' but didn't commit. If they want Dedicated, we need to size GPUs for 2k qps peak. :thinking:
devin_security: From the sec side: Q12 asks about KMS/HSM and key provenance. Also need to confirm whether they require FedRAMP or just SOC2 + customer-managed KMS. If FedRAMP, that's a much longer path.
tara_sol_eng: POC suggestion: 2-week staged run: week1 smoke + throughput + embeddings perf, week2 integration + quality evals + rollback runbook. Suggest we include a short eval harness and a sample prompt set. Example config snippet to propose for routing:
```
policy: 
  - route: low_latency
    model: redwood-open-v1
    priority: 1
  - route: cost_fallback
    model: redwood-quant-v1
    priority: 2
```
This lets them test latency SLOs and fallback behavior.
mike_sre: Ops blockers: we need an IP allowlist for peering, a transport egress estimate (their data plane is in eu-west-1), and a plan for cross-region failover. Also: if they do private deployment, we need at least 3 weeks lead for infra provisioning + certing.
chris_sales_eng: Pricing note — they asked for burst pricing (for seasonal spikes). We can propose commit tiers + hourly burst at 1.5x base unit rate. Will draft numbers, but need expected baseline qps for modeling. ZenPort's draft said ~200 sustained rps with 2 peak minutes at 2k rps/day.
devin_security: Also flag: they asked if we do whitebox pen-tests and vulnerability scan reports for dependencies. We can provide our third-party SCA and internals summary, but full whitebox might require NDA + on-site windows.
elaine_sales: Ok, action items: Tara — can you draft the 2-week POC playbook + sample prompt set and add the config snippet to the capability matrix doc? Chris — please model pricing tiers (baseline, committed, burst) with a 3-line summary for the RFI. Devin — prepare sec answers for KMS/HSM, pen-test policy, and note FedRAMP status. Mike — create ops checklist (peering, IP ranges, egress estimate, provisioning timeline). I'll assemble attachments and submit the RFI package.
redwood-ci-bot: Reminder: shared doc template for RFI is at https://redwood.internal/docs/rfi-template (auto-posted)
chris_sales_eng: I'll ping customer to confirm Dedicated vs Hosted option and baseline qps. ETA for my numbers: tomorrow noon.
tara_sol_eng: Draft POC playbook uploaded to the shared doc, added the sample prompt file and benchmark script notes. left a TODO to include test data anonymization steps.
devin_security: Drafted answers for KMS/HSM Qs and uploaded cert matrix. Noted requirement: if they require HSM-backed customer keys we need legal ok for hosting model artifacts.
mike_sre: Ops checklist uploaded, added egress calc (eu-west-1 -> us-west peering cost estimate) and a 3-week provisioning Gantt.
elaine_sales: Great — everyone, please update your sections by EOD tomorrow so I can finalize before Friday. If anything blocks you speak up here. :thumbsup:
